sentences.en: Showerflower features a simple floral graphic with sans serif text.

sentences.en: Traditional monograms appear in cursive fonts, but if your decor is modern, you may opt for a sans serif font.

sentences.en: Switch from a serif font to a sans serif font like Times New Roman or Arial.
